about_the_game:
A powerful and easy-to-use tool to personalize your visual experience.

• 🚀🖱️ Change atmosphere during gaming or work!

• 👁️ Adjust color and brightness as you wish to protect your eyes!

• 🖼️ Use your JPG/PNG images as screen filters!

(3 eye-protective filters and 3 custom image filters are our gift to you.)

✨ Key Features:

🎨 Color Filters:

- Real-time RGB, saturation, brightness adjustment

- 0-100% transparency control

- Save your filters to a list

- Easily apply / rename / delete your saved filters

🖼️ Image Overlays:

- Add JPG/PNG images via drag-and-drop

- Image transparency adjustment

- Save your images to a list

- Easily apply / change opacity / delete your saved images

💾 Automatic Save Management:

- All settings are automatically saved

- Last used filters and overlays are remembered and automatically set at startup

- Your settings are safe even in unexpected shutdowns

⚡ Ease of Use:

- Instant control with SHIFT + ESC, F1, F2, F3, F4 shortcuts

- Automatic system language detection (30+ languages supported)

- Low resource consumption

🚀 Usage Scenarios:

- 🎮 For Gamers: Night mode, atmospheric color and image filters

- 👁️ Accessibility: Color optimization for visually impaired

- 💻 Daily Use: Reduce eye strain

Transform Your Screen with FilterMob!

The perfect tool for eye protection, changing your work atmosphere, or enhancing visual accessibility.

Easily apply Color and Image (JPG/PNG) filters.

Customize with real-time RGB, saturation, brightness, and transparency adjustments.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 1 GHz processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 520 / AMD Radeon R3
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 1.5 GHz or faster processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 1030 / AMD Radeon RX 550 or higher
  • Storage: 15 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • VR Support: Not supported
